Definition: of Hebrew origin (H6865): Tyrus (i.e. Tsor), a place in Phoenicia:--Tyre.
BiblicalUsage: Tyre is the Phoenician port where Paul landed and stayed seven days on his way to Jerusalem. In Matthew 11:21, had been done in Tyre and Sidon. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Tyre Jesus named in judgment and Paul visited in peace shows me the same city can hear both warning and gospel.
